text:
oncall-bot: P0 PAGE: model-warmup stampede -> widespread OOMs and kernel compile timeouts in prod-west-2. Pager: @samira. Channel auto-created.

samira: acknowledged. grabbing alerts and looking at pods. what are top symptons? 5xx, crashes?

deploy-bot: Alert: endpoint /v1/generate error rate 9.8% since 2501239800. Increased p95 latency.

oliver_sre: nodes west-gpu-3..6 show high pod churn. kube shows RestartCount increments for model-runtime containers. Last kube reason: "OOMKilled" and occasional CrashLoopBackOff.

nick_ops: tailing logs from pod model-run-7b-12: ```kubectl -n prod-west-2 logs model-run-7b-12 -c model-loader --tail=300``` snippet:
```
2026-03-16T02:03:10Z ERROR model-loader: shard-12: read unexpected EOF at offset 1048576
2026-03-16T02:03:10Z WARN model-loader: fallback to eager-shard-read
2026-03-16T02:03:11Z INFO runtime: starting kernel compile for op-attn-1
2026-03-16T02:05:01Z ERROR runtime: kernel compile timeout (150s)
2026-03-16T02:05:02Z ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-16T02:05:02Z INFO runtime: attempting to free device caches
2026-03-16T02:05:05Z FATAL supervisor: container oom during load
```
samira: Hmm shard EOF + compile timeout + OOM. Could be corrupt shard plus compile-stampede because compile cache invalidation/eviction.

oliver_sre: I see a noisy warmup rollout from the warmup-controller: it scheduled ~120 concurrent warmup pods across the pool due to an accidental config flip in infra (parallelism default set to 120). That explains compile concurrency.

nick_ops: checking artifact svc: artifactory shows a transient 503 around 2501239200 during shard uploads for model-v20260316. Some shards reported partial uploads.

samira: plan: 1) pause warmup-controller immediately 2) reduce serving replica concurrency on hot nodes 3) set compile-timeout low to force fast fallback to quantized variant 4) mark suspect artifact as quarantine and roll to previous stable.

oliver_sre: pausing warmup-controller -> ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment warmup-controller --replicas=0``` applied.

deploy-bot: ROUTE ACTION: begin 50% traffic shift for model-family -> fallback-pool-east via smart-router API. Canary applied.

nick_ops: scaling down hot-serving replicas on west-gpu-3..6: ```kubectl -n prod patch deployment model-run-7b --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":2}}' --field-manager=ops-safety'``` applied. Evicting heavy pods.

samira: setting compile timeout lower: pushed `runtime.compile_timeout_ms=45000` via dynamic config. will give up earlier and use fallback. pushed.

oliver_sre: after reducing parallelism and lowering compile timeout, compile timeouts reduced but we still have OOMs because many pods attempted eager-shard-read after lazy fallback failed.

nick_ops: artifactctl reports checksum mismatch for shards [12,13,14] on model-v20260316; source object shows incomplete multipart upload attempts timed out. Marking artifact as suspect.

samira: promoting previous stable: `artifactctl promote model-v20260310-stable --to-serving` -> applied. Forcing in-flight loads to re-resolve.

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC: router now directing 60% to east fallback, 40% still west. Monitoring.

becca_cs: CS alert: two customers (DeltaAnalytics and OrchardAI) reported increased errors and session resets. I've opened high-priority tickets and notified account owners.

oliver_sre: after artifact revert, new pods are starting cleanly; compile counts decreased by 82%. However some nodes are still under memory pressure due to accumulated caches.

nick_ops: running background device cache reclaim on affected nodes: `ssh node && sudo systemctl restart inferenced` to free stale allocations. Doing rolling restarts with PodDisruptionBudgets respected.

samira: re-enabling warmup at a very limited rate: warmup-controller replica=1 and max-parallel=4 for the model family. patch applied.

oliver_sre: setting guard: warmup should not run on nodes where GPU mem usage >70%. Implemented as a scheduler affinity rule in warmup job template.

nick_ops: reupload of shards 12..14 from canonical backup completed and validated with checksums. New artifact v20260316-fixed uploaded and validated.

deploy-bot: NOTE: we will not auto-promote v20260316-fixed until manual validation. safe.

becca_cs: impact summary for ops: DeltaAnalytics saw ~13% error rate for 24m window (~800 failing requests). OrchardAI ~6% errors. No evidence of data compromise. CS will coordinate credits and incident comms.

samira: RCA (prelim): root cause = accidental warmup-controller parallelism config flip combined with a transient artifact upload failure. Combined effect: many concurrent incomplete shard reads, heavy compile concurrency, kernel compile timeouts + OOMs -> pod crashes. Secondary factors: lack of upload checksum gate and warmup scheduling guard.

oliver_sre: Post-incident actions:
- CI: block artifact promotion on shard checksum validation
- Infra: add deploy-time validation for warmup parallelism config (max cap) and safer defaults
- Runtime: implement compile cache persistence across restarts and early-fallback hook to quantized variant on repeated compile timeouts
- Ops: add a node-level GPU mem watermark alert (70%+ sustained) to throttle warmups

nick_ops: created issues in trackers and assigned owners. #INC-5481 (artifact checksum gate), #INFRA-3322 (warmup parallel cap), #RUNTIME-2208 (compile-cache persistence).

samira: will own postmortem draft and timeline. ETA: EOD today. Assigning followups to owners.

becca_cs: customer comms going out now. will follow up with account execs.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate down to 0.9% and p95 latency normalized. Traffic slowly shifting back. Monitoring 40m.

samira: thanks team. reactions :thumbsup: :coffee: — leaving channel open for postmortem notes.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: Primary symptoms resolved. Channel will remain as read-only for postmortem.
